he.text: וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִד אֶל־גָּד צַר־לִי מְאֹד נִפְּלָה־נָּא בְיַד־יְיָ כִּי רַבִּים רַחֲמָיו וּבְיַד אָדָם אַל־אֶפֹּלָה׃

en.text: And David said unto Gad, I am in an exceeding strait, yet let me fall into the hand of the Lord, for abundant is his mercy; but let me not fall into the hand of man.
